conviction_note: Reply gives no numeric guidance and nothing about Q3 2026 has been pre-released. The Q3 numbers are new, and the name's real print-day moves were +3.85, -14.79, +5.11 and -2.06 over its last four releases, so abs_move is 5.0. The evidence is roughly balanced: management said Q3 would be 'sostanzialmente in linea' (broadly in line) with the ~8% organic run-rate, the US acquisition adds about 4 points of reported growth, and Capgemini and Sopra Steria both raised FY26 targets on Q3. Against that, Q3 2025's 18.7% EBITDA margin beat estimates by 9.1%, a hard comparison. So p_up is 53 and the scaled number is (0.06 x 5.0) = +0.3. That is close to impact_sum (+0.45) because no finding is decisive and the Q3 bar is unsourced.

findings.finding: The US federal government and defence acquisition (~EUR100m annual revenue, closed 14 July 2026, consolidated almost fully from Q3) adds about 4 points to Q3 reported revenue growth on top of ~8% organic, so the headline should be about +11-12%. Analysts already model it (Intermonte added just under EUR50m to 2H26).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue beat Intermonte by ~2%; the stock fell 2.06% on the day (after +11% in the three sessions before) and rose 6.38% the next session. Q1 2026 revenue +6.2%: +5.11%.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin surprises have moved the name: Q3 2025's EBITDA beat came with +3.85%; FY25 (12 Mar 2026) fell 14.79% on a print with all indicators positive, which press attributed to very high expectations and possibly margins slightly below expectations.

findings.why_not_priced: The comparison is public, but the 9M margin optics will be new. Capped small because the Q3 bar is unsourced. Net of the rest of the company: the acquired business has margins 'close to the group's', so it should not dilute.

findings.finding: European IT services peers that reported after Reply's July print were firm. Capgemini's Q3 2026 revenue rose 11.7% at constant currency and it raised its FY26 growth target to 9.0-9.5% (30 Oct); Sopra Steria's Q3 organic growth was +4.3% and it raised its FY26 organic target for the second time. The US read is mixed: Cognizant cut the top of its range and EPAM guided Q4 to near-zero growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The name tracks sector AI sentiment: -54% from March 2025 to March 2026 and +68% since the March 2026 low. It rose 6.57% on 1 Oct 2026, the day Accenture's FY27 outlook eased AI fears.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Reply is +10.4% over 60 days and +4.5% over 20. It is a proxy, macro-to-company transmission, so small. If it were fully priced, the stock would have re-rated toward the EUR153 average target rather than trading at EUR132.6.
